description: This PHP source file defines a controller class for managing the shipping total extension in the OpenCart admin panel. It handles displaying the shipping total configuration page and saving configuration settings.

classes.name: Shipping
classes.description: Controller class for the shipping total extension, responsible for rendering the configuration page and handling save operations.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language files, sets page title, prepares breadcrumb navigation, loads header/footer/controllers, and renders the shipping total configuration view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving configuration settings for the shipping total extension, including permission checks and JSON response.
